column2: The nearby miasma is purified.

The nearby miasma is purified.
I forgot to tell you something.
Eek!
It's not only enemies inside the labyrinth.
What's this all of a sudden? If they're not enemies, then what? Are you saying they're friends?
Yes. Mister Vampire and Mister Wizard. And my friends aren't enemies either.
Without the miasma, they're all nice folks.
So, if I destroy the bordermoons...?
They might lend you a hand.
Hmm. And what would they do for me?
They'll give you hints, and sell you materials for dresses.
Wow. That'd be a big help.
That's all I wanted to say. Bye-bye!
Friendly monsters, huh.
But right now, I'm more curious about Father's research.
Um, let's see. The study, maybe? There might be something there. Let's head back to the manor.
I could just keep going ahead, but...
No, no. It's still bugging me. Let's go to the study.
No. "More haste, less speed," as they say.
Don't rush. I need to look around more carefully.
Okay, let's go to Father's bedroom.
Thanks for coming. Please make yourself at home.
Are you done already?
Okay. Please come again.

Thanks for coming. Please make yourself at home.
Are you done already?
Okay. Please come again.
No. I have to look into it properly. The genomroid!
Okay, let's hurry to the basement laboratory.
No. I have to ask Mikhail. About the genomroid!
The nearby miasma is purified.
Thanks for coming. Please make yourself at home.
Are you done already?
Okay. Please come again.
Welcome. Buy something.
The nearby miasma is purified.
Haah, haah.

The nearby miasma is purified.
Welcome. Buy something.
I've stocked some rare goods too. Do buy something.
The nearby miasma is purified.
Say something.
You first.
I have nothing to say.
Neither do I.
I see.
Yes.
What do you want?
Nothing.
That's rather lonely, in its own way.
Even if you say that...
What do you want?
I don't know.
If I don't know, all I can say is I don't know.
...Now that you mention it.
I recall hearing that someone was selling a rare book.
It must be the bible.
Probably, anyway.
If I remember right, it was on B26F...
...Though I'm not very sure.
Why not go take a look for now?
Thanks for coming. Please make yourself at home.
Are you done already?
Okay. Please come again.
The nearby miasma is purified.
Father. Are you all right?
*pant, pant* Oh, Alice.
Just wait a little longer! I'll save you, I promise!
Haah, haah.
I-I did it!
B-but... I think I've... reached my limit too...
Well then. I wonder if I'll find anything.
*rustle* *rustle*
Hmm. There's nothing here.
Oh? What's this? Father's diary?
Right. Sorry, Father, but maybe I'll read just a little of it.
Right now I want every clue I can get. I'm sorry, Father.
But to be honest, reading other people's diaries is fun.
Hehehe. Well then, let's begin. Let's see, what's this...
April 5th:
Today I went out with my daughter.
When was the last time I saw my daughter look so happy?
April 13th:
Today I played with my daughter.
Watching her ever-changing expressions, I felt somehow happy.
April 21st:
The happy days pass peacefully. If only it could stay this way...
Father. You cared about me that much?
Oh no, I'm tearing up... *sniff*
W-well then.
Shall I keep reading?
August 19th:
Unrest is beginning to stir even in our Russia.
We are still safe for now, but before long...
October 23rd:
It seems the tide of the times cannot be stopped.
Before long, something terrible is sure to happen.
December 2nd:
Today, too, many people fought, and died.
At this rate, we are in danger too. I must think of some way out...
What?! It ends here?!
Hey! Just when it was getting to the good part!
Geez. Isn't there any more?
Hmm. Doesn't look like it's here.
If it's anywhere, maybe Father's bedroom? Should I go take a look?
Still, so Father was Russian.
But, huh? I don't remember anything at all about when I lived in Russia.
Hmmm.
No good. I just can't remember.
Phew. Oh well. I'll think about it later.
This comes first. I need to find out more about Father.
Huh?!
Milady.
Please wake up. Lady Alice.
Huh?! W-what? What happened?
Phew. You've finally woken up.
Mikhail?!
Milady. Please don't do anything reckless.
Oh, right. Back then, I was attacked by a monster in the labyrinth...
Please don't worry me so much.
I'm sorry.
Please be careful from now on.
All right. By the way, Mikhail.
Yes? What is it?
Did you just slap me awake?
*gulp*
Aaah! I knew it!
W-well, you see... You wouldn't wake up, so I couldn't help it.
Honestly! What a hopeless butler.
Fine, forget it. But I won't forget this.
Well then, I'm heading out again.
Yes. Take care, milady.
Huh!
You've finally woken up.
Mikhail?! Huh? Where am I?
Oh, right. I went and did it again, didn't I.
After I told you so many times to be careful, and yet you!
Ehehe.
Ehehe is not an answer!
I-I know, okay? I'll be careful next time, so that's enough, right?
Good grief, it can't be helped. Please do be careful.
I know. Well then, I'm off.
Take care, milady.
Oh my, milady? What do you want?
Don't tell me you've abandoned the professor?
Hehehe. Of course, your own life matters more, doesn't it?
Oh, that's not it?
Then why not hurry up and go? It'll be too late, you know?
If you don't mind that, it's no concern of mine. Kekekeke.
Milady? What did you come here for?
Oh, well, just because.
If you have time to dawdle in a place like this, why not hurry up and go out?
If you don't hurry, the professor will surely... Kekeke.
D-don't say such scary things!
And I'd like you to stop laughing like that. It's creepy.
How rude. Do you have a complaint?
No, um, well... I'm sorry.
Come on! Don't just stand there, hurry up and go. The professor is waiting, you know?
O-okay, I get it.
*nab*
...Alice!
Pull yourself together! Alice!
Ugh, uuh...
Oh, Alice!
F-Father. I...
Say nothing. I'm glad you're safe.
This place is dangerous. Come, let's get away from here quickly.
Hm? Where are you going, Alice?
I'm going to defeat Varuudanu again!
What? You've done well. There's no need to push yourself any further!
It has to be me!
Even if we run, we can't get away! So I'll go to it! I'll go and defeat it!
I see. Very well, I won't stop you anymore. Go, Alice.
Yes!
Alice. Wait.
What is it, Father?
Even with the holy sword, if you fight it head-on, you won't leave a single scratch on it.
The shoulder! Aim for its shoulder! There, surely...!
The shoulder...?
All right, Father! I'll try it!
Don't die. Alice...
Are you all right, Alice?
So you're going after all? To defeat it once more?
Yes!
I see. Go. And be sure to come back.
Using this pattern, right?
I've got the bible. I need to find the other one quickly too.
But where am I supposed to make a dress?
It seems there are countless sewing rooms within this labyrinth.
Huh? Really? And? Can I use those sewing machines?
Yes. I looked into it earlier, and those should...
Got it. Well then, I'm off!
Now, milady! Rescue the professor with that holy sword!
Yes, I know! Leave it to me!
O God. Have mercy.
O God. Grant this girl the strength to live once more.
O God. Come down from the great heavens and show Your power.
Huh?!
W-what? What happened?!
Thank goodness. It seems you've woken up.
Mikhail?!
Oh, right. Back then, I...
This time the revival ritual was in time, so it turned out all right...
But there's no telling it will go this well next time!
I-I'm sorry.
I won't stop you, but please be more careful from now on!
O-okay.
Well then, take care, milady. Do be careful this time.
O God. O Heaven. Grant this girl the strength to live once more.
O God. O Earth. Show Your boundless power here, now.
Huh?!
Thank goodness. It seems you've woken up safely.
Ah! Is this the chapel?
Oh, I went and did it again, didn't I.
After I told you so many times to be careful, and yet you!
Ehehe.
Ehehe is not an answer! Honestly, you!
Don't shout. I'll be careful next time, so that's enough, right?
Sigh, it can't be helped. Please be careful this time.
I know, I know! Well then, I'm off.
Take care, milady.
E-ehehe.
Sigh... I won't say anything anymore.
Take care, milady.
